description: Deterministic episode decomposition of frozen V1 replay; each episode begins on owner entering from zero token inventory, ends on owner returning to zero; cashflows reconstructed as follower buy quote outlay, sell quote receipts, fixed modeled gas under each scenario. No new model parameters.
limitations: Episodes are wallet-token turnover episodes, no broad opportunity or token omitted-loser denominator
Historical spot pool choice and persistent pool impact not proven
No real executable backtest or independent AI review
